# Minimal Windows runner stub.
#
# A real Flutter Windows build needs the full runner generated by
# `flutter create` (windows/runner/main.cpp, Runner.rc, flutter/
# CMakeLists, etc.). This file is only a marker so the directory
# structure is visible; do NOT try to build from it directly.
#
# On the build machine, run (see BUILD.md):
#   flutter create --platforms=windows,android --org com.lulu.remote .
# and restore lib/ from git if flutter create overwrites it.
# After that, `flutter build windows --release` produces
# build\windows\x64\runner\Release\lulu_remote.exe.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(lulu_remote)
message(STATUS "LULU Remote Windows runner: regenerate with `flutter create --platforms=windows,android .` (see BUILD.md).")
